notes.title: Bug Fix: Level 5 Boss
notes.notes:
-The weapon is enabled before the level 5 boss is defeated. This has been fixed.
-The laser tutorial is updated.

notes.title: Bug Fix: Enemy Pass Through Walls
notes.notes: Enemies pass through battle arena walls and cannot return to arena. This fix respawns them when this happens
